name: Sorcerer
description: Sorcerers gain bonus ability power and grant ability power to the whole team.

breakpoints.effect: +45 ability power to Sorcerers, +10 to the team
+80 ability power to Sorcerers, +25 to the team

name: Duelist
description: Duelists gain stacking attack speed with every attack, up to 8 stacks.

breakpoints.effect: 12% attack speed per stack and 12% dodge chance

name: Vanguard
description: Vanguards gain armor and magic resist, doubled while above half health.

name: Sniper
description: Snipers gain +1 attack range and deal bonus damage per hex between them and their target.

name: Mystic
description: Your whole team gains magic resist.

name: Blademaster
description: Blademasters have a chance to strike additional times on each attack.

name: Gunner
description: Gunners gain stacking attack damage every time they attack, resetting on takedown windows.

breakpoints.effect: +5% attack damage per stack, max 4 stacks
+8% attack damage per stack, max 5 stacks
+12% attack damage per stack, max 6 stacks
